title: Irresponsible Mom 4x Over the Limit Crashes With 5-Year-Old in the Car
description:
On December 18th, 2024. A woman 4x over the legal limit crashed her car with her 5 year old son in the vehicle.  This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
